args.query:
SELECT eventTime, eventName, eventSource, recipientAccountId,
       userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.type,
       requestParameters, responseElements, errorCode
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventTime > '2026-09-20'
  AND eventName IN ('DeleteAccessKey','DeactivateAccessKey','CreateAccessKey','UpdateAccessKey')
  AND eventTime < '2026-10-16'
ORDER BY eventTime DESC

SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.userName,
       userIdentity.type, requestParameters, responseElements, errorCode
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventTime > '2026-09-19'
  AND eventTime < '2026-10-16'
  AND recipientAccountId = '930416275108'
  AND eventName IN ('DeleteAccessKey','DeactivateAccessKey','CreateAccessKey','UpdateAccessKey')
ORDER BY eventTime DESC

SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.userName,
       awsRegion, requestParameters, responseElements, errorCode
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventTime > '2026-10-11'
  AND eventTime < '2026-10-13'
  AND recipientAccountId = '930416275108'
  AND awsRegion = 'eu-west-3'
  AND eventName IN ('RunInstances','StartInstances','TerminateInstances')
ORDER BY eventTime ASC

SELECT eventTime, eventName, eventSource, awsRegion, recipientAccountId,
       userIdentity, requestParameters, responseElements
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventTime > '2026-09-19'
  AND eventTime < '2026-10-16'
  AND recipientAccountId = '930416275108'
  AND eventName IN ('DeleteAccessKey','CreateAccessKey','UpdateAccessKey','DeactivateAccessKey')
ORDER BY eventTime DESC

SELECT eventTime, eventName, awsRegion, userIdentity, requestParameters, responseElements
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventTime > '2026-10-11'
  AND eventTime < '2026-10-14'
  AND recipientAccountId = '930416275108'
  AND awsRegion = 'eu-west-3'
  AND eventSource = 'ec2.amazonaws.com'
ORDER BY eventTime ASC
